title: centella callioda
intro: Centella callioda, commonly known as Gotu Kola or Asiatic Pennywort, is a perennial plant that belongs to the family Apiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including improving cognitive function, reducing inflammation, and enhancing wound healing, due to its ability to promote tissue repair and regenerate damaged skin. The therapeutic actions of Centella callioda are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Centella callioda work synergistically to provide its numerous health benefits, making it a popular ingredient in traditional remedies and modern supplements.
